Method of Attack: Disguised as legitimate software via free file-hosting services
Spreads via advertising blocks on websites
Malicious Windows shortcut file (.LNK) executing PowerShell commands
Injects attacker-promoted search results into Google and Yandex search pages
Modifies registry keys to disable Windows Defender
Installs malicious browser extensions in Firefox and hijacks Chrome extension
Monitors and replaces cryptocurrency wallet addresses on web pages
Inserts fake donation banners on Wikipedia
Attack Vector: Malicious .LNK shortcut file downloaded from torrent tracker (The Pirate Bay)
Indicators of Compromise: Command and Control server URLs: http://klis.icu/1, http://klis.icu/2, http://klis.icu/3
Dropped executables: servicer.exe and performer.exe in C:\Program Files (x86)\SmartData\
Fake donation cryptocurrency wallet addresses (Bitcoin and Ethereum)
Injected search results promoting TotalAV antivirus
